g.title: crate The engine under `kivact`: a retained tree run in an Arvane window.
crate::a11y Accessibility tree built from the model's semantics and handed to the window.
crate::a11y::build Construct dirty accessibility payloads using the full builder's policy.
crate::a11y::build::dirty Expand dirt using current identity, child-order, clipping and relation metadata.
crate::a11y::build::dirty::local Reuse accepted identity metadata for proven local text updates.
crate::a11y::hash Complete payload fingerprints; never an authority for accepting actions.
crate::a11y::state Accessibility identities, accepted fingerprints and pending invalidation.
crate::a11y::text Publish native editing selections and shaped text runs.
crate::bridge The concrete synchronous bridge between the client and the engine.
crate::check Layout check that finds texts laid out wrong from shapes the engine has.
crate::check::layout_reference Compare retained geometry and baselines with disposable fresh owners.
crate::check::lint Debug-build layout warnings for texts whose box or content changed.
crate::check::lint::state The lint group's state: the texts checked and their box keys.
crate::embed Embedded hosts using the desktop client's turn and rendering loop.
crate::frame_log Opt-in frame timing log for benchmarks (`KIVACT_FRAME_LOG=<path>`).
crate::host Window loop that runs the client's turns, input and frames on demand.
crate::host::client Client callbacks, commit boundaries and thread-safe wake handles.
crate::host::events Shell event conversion and the client's start; callbacks stay on the UI thread.
crate::host::options Passive initial native window settings consumed by the host.
crate::host::testing The in-process test driver of the engine (feature `testing`).
crate::host::testing::self_check Run debug reference comparisons for a settled test host.
crate::host::testing::text_reference Compare normal line queries using disposable retained and rebuilt copies.
crate::host::write Write and read API through which kivact changes the engine's tree in a turn.
crate::host::write::typed The typed property table: one row per prop generates its setter and its `Prop`.
crate::layout Borrow structural topology through the normal lower layout trait.
crate::layout::adapter Adapts the authoritative engine tree and resource measurer to layout.
crate::measure Passive leaf measurement state owned above the structural tree.
crate::measure::editor Optional native editor slot owned by Model, outside the structural tree.
crate::measure::input Incrementally reconcile one explicitly borrowed editor source.
crate::measure::leaf Measurement of layout leaves with Arvane's text shaping and image sizes.
crate::measure::state Slot-indexed measurement and computed-text caches, independent of topology.
crate::model The engine's one model: the node tree, its state groups and the event queue.
crate::model::apply Applies client writes and records changed derived consumers.
crate::model::changes Pending invalidation: one dirty record per node and the global flags.
crate::model::edit The text inputs' editing state, its index, and the IME's view of it.
crate::model::edit::session The IME session of a focusable node that edits its own text.
crate::model::edit::state The edit group's state: the text input index and the IME's last text.
crate::model::events Orders host events and private post-layout commit boundaries.
crate::model::focus Keyboard focus: tab stops, Tab order, focus requests and automatic moves.
crate::model::focus::state The focus group's state: the focus target, its modality and pending reveals.
crate::model::frame Frame clocks, frame requests, smooth scrolls and drawability.
crate::model::frame::state The frame group's state: clocks, frame requests, smooth scrolls and drawability.
crate::model::geometry Read Model-owned layout columns through their normal geometry API.
crate::model::interact Processing that coordinates passive Model-owned groups.
crate::model::interact::caret Project the focused editor caret after scrolling its text.
crate::model::interact::geometry Layout pass, rects, hit testing, scrolling and layout reports for the tree.
crate::model::interact::sticky Sticky boxes laid out in flow, then shifted by their scrollport's scroll.
crate::model::interact::sync Dispatches pending changes to derived work, once per commit or input.
crate::model::interact::text_geometry Text input geometry shared by caret painting, IME positioning and the pointer.
crate::model::interact::visual Placement of a node's parts inside its untransformed layout box.
crate::model::keys Routing of key presses and text input to focus, editing and the client.
crate::model::lifecycle Coordinate structural slots and the Model-owned derived columns.
crate::model::modal Modal overlays that confine input, Tab order and focus to their subtree.
crate::model::modal::state The modal group's state: admitted pointer drags and adopted gestures.
crate::model::pointer Pointer state machine: hover, press, capture, click, drag and wheel routing.
crate::model::pointer::shell Translation of the shell's pointer input into the pointer state machine.
crate::model::pointer::state The pointer group's state: the machine's tracks and the shell's input.
crate::model::pointer::touch Single-touch press-to-scroll arbitration over the native scroll chain.
crate::model::presence Enter and exit paint: where a node starts at mount and ends before it goes.
crate::model::presence::state The presence group's state: nodes awaiting their entrance and leaving subtrees.
crate::model::scrollbar Scrollbar geometry shared by paint and pointer handling.
crate::model::semantics Semantics policy: a node's role, accessible name and assistive actions.
crate::model::state_motion Transitions of state styles; only transitioning nodes allocate them.
crate::model::state_motion::state The state motion group's state: the transitions of moving state styles.
crate::model::states State styles: a node's base paint plus the deltas of its current states.
crate::model::text Model's inherited text projection: the computed text style per node.
crate::model::transform Transforms and z-order that decide where a node is drawn and hit.
crate::mutation Counts client writes independently of derived model synchronization.
crate::native The native window host contract and its initial options.
crate::offscreen Window-independent image output of a scene through the same painting.
crate::paint Conversion of the model's tree into an Arvane display list in paint order.
crate::paint::list The retained, culled paint list of the nodes a frame draws in paint order.
crate::paint::list::index Child index of a container with many children for fast paint list rebuilds.
crate::paint::list::self_check Compare retained paint order, ink and child indices with a fresh walk.
crate::paint::state The paint group's retained paint list and derived node caches.
crate::paint::text Model-aware fill, scene and text painting orchestration.
crate::text_measure Measures text for client drawing callbacks.
crate::tree Authoritative raw node values, stable slots and structural links.
crate::tree::child_order The sole child order, packed for layout and linked during structural writes.
crate::tree::node Raw typed node properties, scenes and direct structural queries.
